newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares higher on convertibility report.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares higher on convertibility report.

text.p: Delhi shares quoted higher in early trade on Thursday as foreign investors made hectic purchases, spurred by a panel's recomendations to make the rupee fully convertible over time, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was up 1.80 points at 809.29 after 30 minutes of trade.
"Favourable recommendations made by a committee set up by the Reserve Bank of India fuelled buying," said Yogesh Sethi of brokers Vinayaka Investments.
On Tuesday, a committee appointed by the central bank submitted its recommendations, suggesting a timetable and guidelines for making the rupee convertible on capital account.
State Bank of India gained 0.70 rupee to 322.25.
TELCO was up one rupee at 402.
